verdict.rationale: Typesense Cloud offers 'GPU Acceleration: Use GPUs for embedding generation' (typesense-docs-23), and the install guide has an optional GPU section (typesense-docs-7). Together these imply the engine generates embeddings itself. Semantic and hybrid search are documented and demoed (typesense-docs-9, typesense-docs-40, typesense-gh-3). However, no evidence explicitly describes automatic vectorization of documents and queries at index and search time, or which embedding models and providers are supported. missing for 10: explicit docs on built-in auto-embedding fields, supported models or remote providers, confirmation that queries are vectorized automatically, independent hands-on corroboration.
